config.design: Prospective64 pairs: eight source pairs per task, four fixed context conditions. Frozen H949 fits and H848 relay bases. No output-dependent replacements. Native competence gate unchanged: >=4 valid pairs, >=.75 both endpoints binary, >=.5 intended fullvocab. Retain all valid pairs including failed cells.
config.fresh_scope: Full prompts checked disjoint from H849 and original discovery source; new source list, not entire-research/pretraining disjointness.
config.distance: Context composition intervention, not controlled distance: relative clauses/opposite-number attractors for agreement; negation/opposing opening for sentiment; baseline and alternate context controls.
config.arms: Full donor preMLP4 relay; own rank1; complement; other-task rank1. Site fixed, same relay token and absolute position required.
config.interpretation: Task contrast compression, not unsupervised manifold recovery. Donor contrast supplies coefficients. Site/coordinate system must stay fixed; no fallback relay selection on failed gap variants.
